title: Rama's 3 life hacks

verse.sanskrit:
कच्चिदर्थं विनिश्चित्य लघुमूलं महोदयम् ।
क्षिप्रमारभसे कर्तुं न दीर्घयसि राघव ॥
verse.iast:
kaccid arthaṃ viniścitya laghumūlaṃ mahodayam |
kṣipram ārabhase kartuṃ na dīrghayasi rāghava ||
verse.translation: Having settled on a goal that costs little and yields much, do you start on it quickly and not drag it out, Raghava?

beats.title: 3 life hacks from the Ramayana
beats.vo: When Bharata finds Rama in the forest, Rama hits him with a checklist. It's lowkey a productivity podcast.
One. Don't let sleep run you. Wake up on time, and use the quiet hours before dawn to think.
Two. Don't decide big things alone, or with the whole group chat. And don't let your plan leak before it's done.
Three. Found something low effort and high reward? Start it now. Don't drag it out.
Once you've picked a goal that costs little and gives a lot, do you start fast, and not delay?

beats.title: Run your life like a kingdom
beats.vo: Rama said this to someone about to run a kingdom. You're running your life. Same rules.

beats.title: Save this for your 5 AM era
beats.vo: Save this for your five a.m. era. Day three of learning from Rama.

caption:
Rama's productivity checklist for Bharata, 2 kandas before 'that girl' routines existed 📋

1. Don't let sleep run you (Ayodhya Kanda 100.18)
2. Don't plan alone or with everyone; don't leak the plan (100.19)
3. Low effort, high reward? Start now (100.20)

“कच्चिदर्थं विनिश्चित्य लघुमूलं महोदयम् । क्षिप्रमारभसे कर्तुं न दीर्घयसि राघव ॥”
